tei:div.tei:p:
In the seventh month, on the first day of the month, you shall have a sacred assembly; you may not do any form of work, a day of Teruah shall it be for you. You shall prepare a whole-offering of sweet savour to the Lord, one young bullock, one ram, seven flawless lambs in their first year. Their meal-offering shall be of flour mixed with oil, three tenths for the bullock, two tenths for the ram and one tenth
for each of the seven lambs. And also one he-goat as a sin-offering to atone for you. Apart from the whole-offering of the new moon and its meal-offering and the regular whole-offering with its meal-offering and their drink-offerings according to their rule for a sweet savour, a fire offering to the Lord.
